policy: Before adding or changing any CDN <script>/<link> reference in this project, read this file FIRST and use the listed primary URL. If the primary is unreachable, use the listed fallbacks in order — do not reach for an untracked provider. If a library isn't listed here yet, add an entry as part of the same change instead of hardcoding a one-off URL. If every listed source is blocked, stop and ask the human before picking a new, untracked provider.

react.notes: unpkg.com was network-blocked in the environment that surfaced issue #157's 'ReactDOM is not defined' bug; jsDelivr (already used for Bootstrap in the same files) is primary now. Keep unpkg listed only as a fallback, not a first choice.

react-dom.notes: Same rationale as react above — load order must stay react -> react-dom -> the page's own script.

babel-standalone.notes: Not yet migrated off unpkg.com — see knownDrift below. Out of scope for issue #157; flagged for a future ticket.

knownDrift.issue: Still loads react@18 and react-dom@18 from unpkg.com (lines 58-59) instead of the jsDelivr primary used by index.html/album-promo.html. Not fixed as part of this change to avoid unrequested scope creep — a future ticket should align it with this config.
